g.text: Five distinct directions. Different voices, different levels of detail.
Flowing ribbons, electric blue, and warm orange.
An observant owl with a reading lens and attitude.
Expressive serif lettering and a folded-page signature.
Chunky, staggered letters with a punch of orange.
An engraved inspection seal with an eye for detail.
D brings a louder, friendlier voice.
Concepts only. The live app is unchanged.
